messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for the SOC 2 fieldwork tomorrow we need artifacts that show ephemeral KMS key rotation for inference workers and evidence that recent RBAC changes didn't leave lingering grants. Specifically: samples that prove rotation events, a sampling plan, and any playbooks used for forensic playback. Also need proof of the service-account -> key grant delta for last 90 days.

mari: hey @auditor_jane — noted. short answers then links. we rotate ephemeral keys every 6 hours via the key broker. RBAC changes are tracked in infra PRs and backed by audit logs. i can assemble a sample bundle.

gabe: adding context — the inference service uses envelope encryption: data keys are generated per-request by the key-broker service, wrapped with a customer-managed KMS key (cmk-inference-prod). we rotate the cmk via a key policy step but the per-request ephemeral DEKs are short-lived.

auditor_jane: useful. auditor needs a runnable sample: logs that show wrap/unwrap for a rotation event + the PR that removed a role binding last sprint. also we need the Splunk query you used to pull unwrap events.

mari: ok — i'll package 3 artifacts: 1) unwrap/wrap log snapshots for two rotation windows, 2) PR diffs for RBAC changes, 3) a short sampling doc that maps evidence to SOC control IDs.

mari: s3 path for bundle (will upload in a few mins): s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-22/ephemeral-kms-sample-2. includes checksums and README.

gabe: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 (service-account RBAC prune) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/key-broker/pull/298 (rotation automation). both have audit trail links and reviewer comments.

sre_lee: Splunk/CloudWatch query we used to extract unwrap events:
```
index=platform_logs service=key-broker event=unwrap OR event=wrap | stats count by event, key_id, user, src_ip, _time | sort -_time
```
filter for key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/cmk-inference-prod and time range the auditor wants.

mari: retention note: full KMS audit logs are kept in our logging tier for 13 months. we will provide both raw log snippets and a pre-signed, redacted replay for the auditor.

auditor_jane: redacted replay is fine. we need a short chain-of-custody note that explains how snapshots were taken and who signed off. can you include the oncall signoff?

mari: yes — will include a custody.md describing the snapshot commands and checksums and an approvals.csv with approver, timestamp, and reason. approver will be @sre_lee.

oncall_bot: Deploy succeeded: key-broker rotation job v2.14 completed at 2026-03-21T22:12:03Z (job-id: rot-20260321-2212).

sre_lee: i signed off on the rotation window at 2026-03-21T22:20:00Z. i'll attach the verification steps and my short note in approvals.csv.

mari: sample selection plan (short):
- population: all wrap/unwrap events for cmk-inference-prod over last 90 days
- sampling method: stratified by day and by service-account that performed unwraps
- sample size: 5 rotation windows + 10 random unwrap events per window
- deliverables: raw log snippets (.ndjson), a redacted replay, PR diffs, custody.md, approvals.csv

auditor_jane: great. last ask: can you also show that revoking an RBAC binding removes key grants from the service account identity within 24 hours? a simple before/after proof is fine.

gabe: yes — we have a short script that queries IAM bindings and KMS grants. command we ran:
```
# snapshot before revoke
python tools/iam_snapshot.py --project inference --out before.json
# revoke PR merged
# snapshot after 24h
python tools/iam_snapshot.py --project inference --out after.json
# diff: jq -S . before.json after.json > grant-diff.json
```
we will include before.json, after.json, and grant-diff.json in the bundle.

mari: ETA: uploading bundle and index.json in s3 by EOD PST. i'll ping here when done and post the presigned URLs.

auditor_jane: perfect. thanks all — that will do for now. if possible please include the exact mapping from each artifact to SOC control IDs (CC6, CC7, logging controls). helps speed review. :pray:

mari: will add control_map.csv mapping artifacts -> control IDs and short notes. pinging when uploaded. :thumbsup:
